reviewed_by: Codex manual causal source, pinned original tests, and command review 2026-10-25
review_notes: Restore OpenAPI3 deprecated metadata to the parameter, removing it from the nested schema; OpenAPI2 remains flat. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
module = importlib.import_module('apispec.ext.marshmallow.openapi')
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/openapi.py').resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from marshmallow import fields
from apispec import APISpec
from apispec.ext.marshmallow import MarshmallowPlugin
for version in ("2.0","3.0.0"):
 plugin=MarshmallowPlugin()
 APISpec(title="metadata", version="1", openapi_version=version, plugins=[plugin])
 field=fields.Str(metadata={"deprecated":True,"description":"old query"})
 observed=plugin.converter._field2parameter(field,name="query",location="query")
 print("version",version,"parameter",observed)
 assert observed["deprecated"] is True
 assert observed["description"]=="old query"
 if version.startswith("3"):
  assert "deprecated" not in observed["schema"]
  assert "description" not in observed["schema"]
PYREPLAY
